name: Elemental Favor
description: You channel the fury of the elemental planes into your strikes. Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit. Choose the damage type when you cast the spell: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.
